text:
Situation: Dexmedetomidine hydrochloride injection has been on FDA's shortage list for 78 months as of 2026-10-21. Our 100 ug/mL, 2 mL vial (NDC 0143-9532-25) is labeled Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. at both Corvale East and Corvale General. Corvale East holds 59 vials at 7.1 per day for 8.3 days on hand. Corvale General holds 159 vials at 7.7 per day for 20.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows dexmedetomidine hydrochloride injection as Current with an initial posting date of 2020-04-10 and an update date of 2026-09-15 for Accord Healthcare Inc. citing discontinuation of manufacture. Additional manufacturers on the Current list include Amneal Pharmaceuticals (update 2026-10-06), Azurity Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (update 2026-10-15), Baxter Healthcare (update 2026-10-16), Eugia US LLC (update 2026-10-19), Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (update 2026-10-15), Gland Pharma Limited (update 2026-07-22), Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. (update 2026-10-14), HQ Specialty Pharma (update 2026-10-01), Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. (US Agent eVenus Pharmaceutical Laboratories, Inc.) (update 2026-10-14), Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. (update 2026-10-05), and Meitheal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (update 2026-08-27).

Our position: Corvale East has critically low supply of the 100 ug/mL, 2 mL vial. Corvale General has sufficient inventory to support a transfer while maintaining adequate days on hand. Other concentrations and sites have varying stock levels but are not the immediate focus.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 41 vials of 100 ug/mL, 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Avenacy Inc. — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names HENGRUI PHARMA plant — needs buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from CIVICA, INC. — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place — needs buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Precision Dose, Inc. — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place — needs buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Sagent Pharmaceuticals — not on FDA's shortage list today; label names no plant we could place — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or alternative agent substitutions; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
